product_one_liner: AI-Powered Shipment Management for Commodity Traders
product_description_excerpt: We make it easy for commodity traders manage their shipments. The largest U.S. sugar trader uses our AI-automation platform to track thousands of shipments and process over a million shipping documents. Our team consists of an experienced commodity trader with 8 years of experience and two skilled engineers with a combined 13 years of experience from Samsara and Autodesk.
